course_name: 數位訊號處理進階與實務
outline:
Course Topic #1: Basic
1-1: DSP Introduction: Technology, Market, Product, Research
1-2: SPEC061 Introduction: H/W, I/O, A/D, D/A, Interrupt, Timer, Memory
1-3: Un’SP Introduction: S/W, Asm./C Compiler, Linker, Debug, Simulator, Memory Management
1-4: Addressing Mode: Direct, Indirect, Reg-based, Bit-reverse, Circular, ++, --
1-5: Fixed-Point Operation: +, -, *, (Mantissa, Exponent)
1-6: Division Operation: Table, Div-algorithm
1-7: Parallel Operation: Correlation, Summation, Inner-Product
1-8: Special Case: Hamming Window, Durbin Algorithm
Course Topic #2: Application-I, DSP Algorithm
2-1: Audio Processing: Record, Play, Echo, Tone Generation, Digital Oscillator, DTMF Generator, Cadence Tone Detection
2-2: Filter Design: IIR, FIR, LPF, Chebyshv Algorithm
2-3: Tone Detection: Goertzel Algorithm, MSTD Algorithm, DTMF Detector, Cadence Tone Detection
2-4: Spectrum Analysis: Correlation, QC-FD, DCT, FFT
2-5: Echo Cancellation: LMS, RLS, Echo Suppressor
2-6: Noise Cancellation: Euro-Tele. Com.
2-7: Pattern Recognition: VQ, MLP, RNN
2-8: Speech Codec-I: PCM(A,u), ADPCM
2-9: Speech Codec-II: LPC-10, CELP-4.8k, G.729, MELP
2-10:Video Codec: VQ, MPEG, H.263
Course Topic #3: Application-II, G.729
3-1: Pre-Processing: LPF, Hamming Window
3-2: Pitch Detection: Open-Loop Pitch Detection
3-3: LPC/LSP: Durbin Algorithm, Chebyshv Equ. MSVQ
3-4: Long-Term Prediction:
3-5: Short-Term Prediction:
